run_ProcessManager: run a ProcessManager with a list of ProcessInfo objects to start and monitor multiple child processes
create_ProcessInfo: create a ProcessInfo dataclass with a module name and optional args to describe a child process
manage_ProcessManagerState: manage shared ProcessManagerState across processes using an mp.Manager for thread-safe phase and exception tracking
handle_ProcessManagerException: handle a ProcessManagerException to inspect failures, exceptions, and phases of crashed or hanged processes
use_ProcessPhase: use the ProcessPhase enum to track process lifecycle states from STARTING through TERMINATED
